FLUSO.name: Remembered.
FLUSO.mechanic: One loaded word over a warm, human photo

ref.title: "Keep thinking" (Claude's first brand campaign, by Mother)
ref.why: A 90-second film where the word "problem" flashes on screen over a warm, retro palette, plus out-of-home ads starring real people who built things with Claude. It avoids the cold, glowing-brain AI look entirely, so the brand feels human and confident.

FLUSO.steal: One huge word that names the feeling, set over a real professional at a real desk. Warm film grain instead of tech gradients.
FLUSO.intro: You said "I'll send it tomorrow." Fluso remembered and drafted it for you.
FLUSO.headline: Remembered.  The follow-up you forgot? Fluso already drafted it.
FLUSO.visual: Golden-hour photo of a lawyer at a cluttered desk. The giant cream serif word sits across the top third, with a small wordmark and a CTA pill at the bottom.
FLUSO.li_headline: The AI workspace that remembers what you promised
FLUSO.audience: Partners and associates at law firms, plus fund and deal teams. Job function Legal or Finance, seniority Senior and up.

FLUSO.name: Your to-do list, written for you

ref.title: Introducing Notion 3.0: Agents
ref.why: Notion sells its agent by showing calm, finished work on screen. It doesn't explain the AI. A teammate-built-in story told through one clean UI.

FLUSO.steal: Fluso's real differentiator, proactive task detection, shown as a single screenshot: four tasks it found, each tagged with where it came from (Slack, Outlook, Gmail).
FLUSO.intro: Fluso reads across Gmail, Slack and Outlook and tells you what you owe people, before they chase you.
FLUSO.headline: Your to-do list, written for you.
FLUSO.visual: Off-white background with one floating Fluso panel: "Today, Fluso found 4 things you owe people." Each row carries a source chip, and one carries a green "Draft ready" tag.
FLUSO.li_headline: Fluso finds the work. You approve it.
FLUSO.audience: Ops leads, chiefs of staff, EAs and managers at 50–5,000-person companies using Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.

FLUSO.name: 214 unread → 3 decisions

ref.title: Superhuman AI 2.0
ref.why: Superhuman's AI story is a transformation you can count: summaries, auto-drafts and an inbox that empties. The number is the proof.

FLUSO.steal: The chaos-to-calm split. Left is grey noise; right is three clean decisions. Readable in under a second in the feed.
FLUSO.intro: Stop triaging. Fluso turns your inbox, Slack and calendar into the 3 decisions that need you.
FLUSO.headline: 214 unread → 3 decisions.
FLUSO.visual: Split frame. Left: an overloaded grey inbox with a red badge reading "214 unread". Right: a warm off-white panel with three checkbox cards reading "3 decisions". A bottom band explains how.
FLUSO.audience: Retarget fluso.ai visitors and Fluso free-tier users. Lookalike on Plus/Pro signups.

FLUSO.name: Fluso noticed
FLUSO.mechanic: One notification tells the whole story

ref.title: Introducing North (secure AI workspace)
ref.why: North is the closest competitor to Fluso: a private, enterprise AI workspace. Its launch video shows agents doing real tasks across tools. Study it so ours is shorter, sharper and more proactive.

FLUSO.steal: Their "agent does the task" demo, but compressed into a single proactive moment. Fluso acts before you ask, which North's video doesn't show.
beats: Dark desk at night with a laptop asleep. The phone buzzes.
A frosted notification slides in: "Fluso noticed: You promised Sarah the term sheet by 5pm. A draft is ready."
Click "Review draft". The draft opens in Gmail and the cursor hovers over Send. Caption: "Nothing sends until you approve."
End card: "Fluso. The work finds you." Download free.
FLUSO.li_headline: The AI workspace that acts first
FLUSO.audience: Broad professional audience in the US, UK and EU. Use this as the awareness video to build retargeting pools for F2 and F3.

FLUSO.name: She left at 6:05
FLUSO.mechanic: Human outcome, no product on screen until the last beat

ref.title: ChatGPT's first brand campaign (coverage)
ref.why: OpenAI's brand spots are shot like warm indie films about everyday life, with ChatGPT barely visible. They sell the outcome (a life that's a bit easier), not the model.

FLUSO.steal: The payoff is a person leaving work on time. Fluso is the reason, shown in one line of copy, not a UI tour.
beats: 17:58 on a desk clock. A fund analyst faces a wall of open tabs.
Close-up on the laptop: "Fluso: 3 drafts ready." Approve, approve, approve.
She walks out into the dusk, coat over her shoulder. Super: "Fluso drafted it at 6. She left at 6:05."
FLUSO.audience: Hedge fund, private equity and banking analysts and associates. Seniority Entry to Senior.

FLUSO.name: For counsel. For funds. For clinicians.

ref.title: Work Without Boundaries
ref.why: Harvey wins law firms by speaking only to lawyers, in their language and their settings. Narrow beats broad when the buyer is regulated.

FLUSO.steal: One 6-second bumper per vertical Fluso was built with (law firms, hedge funds and hospitals), each targeted to that industry only.
beats: A vertical artifact appears: a contract redline, an investment committee memo, or a discharge summary.
Fluso drafts it in the house template and every figure is traced to its source ("Drawn from: Slack #deals, Q3 model.xlsx").
End card: "For counsel.", "For funds." or "For clinicians.", then "One private AI workspace. Fluso."
FLUSO.li_headline: Built with law firms, funds and hospitals
FLUSO.audience: Three ad sets split by industry: Legal Services, Investment Management and Hospitals & Health Care.

ENCLAVE.name: Stays in your cluster

ref.title: "Privacy. That's iPhone."
ref.why: Apple turned privacy into a brand promise with one confident sentence ("What happens on your iPhone, stays on your iPhone.") and huge type with no product shot.

ENCLAVE.steal: The same sentence structure, aimed at infrastructure buyers. Black, white and one line. It reads as confidence, which is what a CISO buys.
ENCLAVE.intro: Run frontier open-weight models on your own GPUs, encrypted in use across the entire cluster. No new hardware.
ENCLAVE.headline: What runs in your cluster, stays in your cluster.
ENCLAVE.visual: Matte black square with massive white sans-serif type, a small grey product line and a thin padlock icon.
ENCLAVE.li_headline: Confidential computing for the whole GPU cluster
ENCLAVE.audience: CISOs, CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure and Heads of AI at banks, insurers, government and defense. US, UK and EU, plus Switzerland for banks.

ENCLAVE.name: Trust us → the proof
ENCLAVE.mechanic: Anti-thesis: name the industry's bad habit and refuse it

ref.title: Super Bowl 2026: "Betrayal" ("Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude.")
ref.why: Anthropic named what the rest of the category was doing (ads inside AI chats) and positioned against it. Claude's daily active users rose about 11% after it aired.

ENCLAVE.steal: The enemy is "trust us" security. Our refusal is cryptographic proof: hardware attestation you can check yourself.
ENCLAVE.intro: Every other AI cloud asks for your trust. Enclave gives you a hardware attestation you can verify yourself.
ENCLAVE.headline: Most AI infrastructure says: trust us. Enclave hands you the proof.
ENCLAVE.visual: Off-white paper with "trust us" struck through in red. A deep-red notary-style seal reads "Hardware attested · Verified".
ENCLAVE.li_headline: Don't trust your AI infrastructure. Verify it.
ENCLAVE.audience: Security and compliance leaders (CISO, DPO, Head of Risk) in financial services and healthcare.

ENCLAVE.name: Not even we can see inside
ENCLAVE.mechanic: A visual metaphor with the vendor admitting its own limits

ref.title: Lumo, the private AI assistant (launch coverage)
ref.why: Proton sells "zero-access": even Proton can't read your data. Admitting what the vendor can't do is the most credible privacy claim there is.

ENCLAVE.steal: A sealed, frosted box that a Prem employee can't see into. The vendor's own powerlessness is the selling point.
ENCLAVE.intro: Your models and data stay encrypted while they're processed. Not your cloud provider, not your admins, not even Prem can look inside.
ENCLAVE.headline: Not even we can see inside.
ENCLAVE.visual: A frosted-glass cube sealing a glowing GPU server in a minimal grey studio. A person leans in from behind and can't see anything.
ENCLAVE.audience: Sovereign cloud providers, telcos and GPU operators, plus public-sector IT.

ENCLAVE.name: Lot 47

ref.title: Privacy on iPhone: "Data Auction"
ref.why: Apple staged an auction of a person's emails, location and purchases, then ended it with one tap. An invisible risk becomes a scene nobody forgets.

ENCLAVE.steal: The auction, aimed at the enterprise: what goes under the hammer is a bank's unencrypted AI workload.
beats: A hushed auction room. Paddles go up.
The auctioneer reads: "Lot 47: a bank's credit memos, as processed by its AI."
Lights flicker. The lot card turns to ciphertext and the bidders lower their paddles, confused.
Super: "Encrypted while in use. Across the whole cluster. Prem Enclave."
ENCLAVE.li_headline: Your AI workloads aren't for sale
ENCLAVE.audience: Banking and insurance leadership, CIO and CISO. Video views feed retargeting for E1 and E2.

ENCLAVE.name: The whole cluster
ENCLAVE.mechanic: A CGI explainer of one technical idea

ref.title: What is NVIDIA Confidential Computing?
ref.why: NVIDIA explains GPU confidential computing with clean 3D: the protected zone is something you can see. Infrastructure buyers expect this visual language.

ENCLAVE.steal: The visible protection field, extended to Enclave's real difference: it covers the whole distributed cluster, not one machine.
beats: One GPU glows inside a lock. Caption: "Confidential computing usually protects one machine."
A crystalline encryption lattice spreads rack to rack across the whole data center.
Super: "Not one machine. The whole cluster. No new hardware." Prem Enclave.
ENCLAVE.audience: Infrastructure and platform engineering leaders, GPU cloud operators and data center owners.

ENCLAVE.mechanic: Dark humor with the attacker as the protagonist

ref.title: "Stopping Bad Actors" (with Tommy Wiseau)
ref.why: 1Password makes enterprise security funny by putting the bad actor center stage. Humor gets a dry category remembered and shared.

ENCLAVE.steal: A future hacker who stole the data years ago and still can't open it. It explains "harvest now, decrypt later" in 8 seconds.
beats: A dim room with a wall calendar showing 2035. A hacker plugs in a drive labelled "bank_data_2026".
A quantum rig whirs. Screen: "DECRYPTION FAILED: ML-KEM-768." Head in hands.
Super: "Harvest now, decrypt later? Not here. Post-quantum from day one. Prem Enclave."
ENCLAVE.audience: CISOs and security architects, plus government and defense. Interest targeting: post-quantum cryptography and zero trust.

API.name: Every token, encrypted

ref.title: "The Intelligence Age" (Super Bowl LIX)
ref.why: OpenAI's first Super Bowl spot was made from black-and-white dots that form humanity's big inventions. It's restrained, iconic and instantly recognisable in a loud ad break.

API.steal: The dot technique as a static: a padlock made of thousands of dots, like tokens streaming in and locking.
API.intro: Frontier open-weight models through one OpenAI-compatible API. Every request encrypted, attested and never stored.
API.headline: Every token, encrypted.
API.visual: A black-and-white dot-matrix padlock assembling from streaming dots. Mono type and one lime accent dot.
API.li_headline: Encrypted LLM inference. Zero data retention.
API.audience: AI/ML engineers, platform engineers, Heads of AI. Interests: LLMOps and AI security.

API.name: Change one line

ref.title: Cursor 2.0: Composer and the new UX
ref.why: Cursor markets to developers with the editor itself: real code, real UI, no metaphors. Developers trust what they can read.

API.steal: The migration is the ad: an OpenAI client where only base_url changes. Dev buyers see the effort is one line.
API.intro: Already on the OpenAI SDK? Point base_url at Prem Enclave and every call runs encrypted in a hardware TEE.
API.headline: Change one line. Encrypt every call.
API.visual: A dark code editor with the Python OpenAI client and the base_url line glowing lime.
API.audience: Software engineers and engineering managers at regulated companies who already follow OpenAI or Hugging Face pages.

API.name: <40ms

ref.title: Cerebras Inference in 30 seconds
ref.why: Cerebras owns "fastest inference" by leading with one number every time. For devs, a benchmark is the headline.

API.steal: Kill the objection that privacy costs performance, using one number from Prem's own launch material.
API.intro: Encrypted inference used to mean slow inference. Prem Enclave API: under 40ms, OpenAI-compatible, zero data retention.
API.headline: <40ms. Encrypted inference used to be slow. Not anymore.
API.visual: Green-black grid with a giant white "<40ms" and a lime "Not anymore."
API.li_headline: Private inference without the latency tax
API.audience: CTOs and AI leads evaluating LLM vendors. Retarget docs.prem.io visitors.

API.name: One curl

ref.title: Ship 26 NYC: Opening Keynote
ref.why: Vercel's launch films treat typography and the terminal as motion design: fast, black, precise. Developer brands that look like their product.

API.steal: The whole product in one command. The payoff is the attestation line turning green.
beats: A cursor blinks, then types: "$ curl prem-enclave/v1/chat/completions"
The JSON response streams in at speed.
The last line flashes lime: "attestation: verified ✓ (GPU TEE)". End: "OpenAI-compatible. Encrypted. Verified."
API.li_headline: Your first encrypted call takes a minute
API.audience: Developers. This is the most direct and cheapest test for API signups.

API.name: Swiss-encrypted
API.mechanic: Provenance and sovereignty as a brand asset

ref.title: Introducing le Chat
ref.why: Mistral turns being European into a feature: sovereignty, open weights, an alternative to US labs. That plays directly to EU buyers.

API.steal: Prem's Swiss base as a trust signal: the Swiss cross morphs into a lock.
beats: Crisp Alpine peaks with clean air and a slow push-in.
A red square with a white cross morphs into a padlock.
Open-weight model families tick past. Super: "Frontier open models. Swiss-encrypted. Zero data retention."
API.audience: EU (DE, AT, PL, FR, NL) and Switzerland. Data-protection-sensitive industries.

API.name: Every answer comes with a receipt
API.mechanic: A physical metaphor for a digital proof

ref.title: Apple Intelligence (Private Cloud Compute era)
ref.why: Apple made private cloud AI feel tangible to normal people. Its trick is translating a cryptographic guarantee into something you can almost hold.

API.steal: Attestation as a till receipt. Each answer prints proof: TEE verified, 0 bytes retained, keys yours.
beats: Left: a question is typed and the answer streams in.
Right: a thermal receipt prints and curls: "ATTESTATION RECEIPT · TEE: VERIFIED · DATA RETAINED: 0 BYTES · KEYS: YOURS".
Super: "Every answer comes with a receipt. Prem Enclave API."
API.audience: Compliance-minded technical buyers in fintech, healthtech and govtech.
